_source: Hand-written sample prompts in the spirit of Google IFEval (Zhou et al., 2023). For the full benchmark (~541 prompts, 25 rule families), download from https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/IFEval and convert each `instruction_id_list` + `kwargs` entry into the `rules` schema below. The full ruleset and reference checkers live in https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/instruction_following_eval.
_license_note: Hand-written prompts, authored for this repo.
_note: FORM-ONLY instruction following. Every rule is verifiable without knowing the correct answer, matching the Google IFEval design. Correctness belongs to the mmlu/hellaswag suites: mixing the two hides an instruction-following delta behind a reasoning ceiling. SIZED FOR POWER: at 26 items a 34.6% -> 46.2% move was a 3-item swing at p=0.40, i.e. unresolvable, and per-family rates ran off n=2. 280 items puts ~30 behind every family so a family rate means something and a ~10pt aggregate move clears 80% power. Grow this set, never shrink it, and re-measure every baseline on the same instrument whenever it changes.
